create_client_service_compiler_env: create a ClientServiceCompilerEnv instance connected to a gRPC compiler service endpoint
reset_environment_with_benchmark: reset the compiler environment with a specified benchmark and observation space
step_with_action: take a single action step in the compiler environment and return observations and rewards
fork_environment: fork the current compiler environment to create an independent copy with the same state
send_params_to_service: send key value parameters to the compiler service for runtime configuration
